entries.title: A Help menu
entries.text: The ? at the top right opens a short tour, the glossary, a way to send feedback and this list. The tour works on your own data as well as on the sample.

entries.title: Costs and tools are easier to find
entries.text: Settings now links to Costs, to the Data Doctor, to checking a campaign another tool ran, and to the campaigns that are waiting for their results.

entries.title: Quieter pages
entries.text: Pages no longer ask for results that cannot exist yet, such as the results of a campaign that has not finished. An empty page now says what to do next.

entries.title: Value Proof Packs
entries.text: Each measured campaign has a one-page proof of what it was worth in rupees, with the range and the groups it did not help. It is under Reports.

entries.title: A worked example on public data
entries.text: E-mail Offer Choice shows the whole journey on a public e-mail test: who to contact, which offer, and what the campaign changed against a comparison group.
